0x00375C.en: 「I am the father of a new humanity...the New Progenitor」

0x003799.en: 「I have obtained the Akasha variable factor.」

0x0037D0.en: 「I am the last and true arbiter...」

0x003807.en: 「My future will change... and countless worlds with it.」

0x00384A.en: 「With the Akasha variable factor,/ I break free from the cursed cycle.」

0x00389D.en: 「This Adamatron is/ the Cross Gate Paradigm System...」

0x003905.en: 「Through the gate where space-time crosses,/ I become the law of many worlds.」

0x00395B.en: 「Praise the New Progenitor's birth, and vanish.」

0x003992.en: 「I have it now.../ the missing memory, and the factor.」

0x0039DF.en: 「Hear the New Progenitor's cry and be erased.」

0x003A44.en: 「Earth shall become,/ in the truest sense, the 'Land of Beginning'」

0x003A8E.en: 「I am the new Adam, and the Metatron.」

0x003AD1.en: 「You whom Aulef found.../ I need no longer await your awakening.」

0x003B30.en: 「Ryusei Date.../ as material, you're no longer needed.」

0x003B86.en: 「Not only in this world.../ I have crossed blades with you many times.」

0x003BF1.en: 「My battles with you.../ do you know how many times now?」

0x003C47.en: 「I know of your existence.../ no, I 'remember' it.」

0x003C94.en: 「You exist in my distant, cursed memory...」

0x003CD4.en: 「Compared to then,/ the ties between you seem to have grown thin.」

0x003D46.en: 「Unlike my past life, your world is small...」

0x003D86.en: 「Has the pain of losing Aulef healed yet?」

0x003DF7.en: 「If breaking free of your shackles/ is your destiny...」

0x003E41.en: 「Levi... your misfortune was/ not being under me in this world.」

0x003E9A.en: 「No need to revive Levi's persona./ Just disappear.」

0x003EE4.en: 「Cybuster.../ and Masaki Andoh./ You too, I 'remember'」

0x003F68.en: 「Shu Shirakawa.../ you seem different from back then.」

0x003FB2.en: 「Gilliam.../ a man bearing a fate like yet unlike mine...」

0x004002.en: 「Now I see it.../ there is something you lack.」

0x00412E.en: 「There's no need for two keys to open the gate...」

0x004165.en: 「Share the same fate as the Dark Wisdom.」

0x00419C.en: 「Where you'll end up is already decided.」

0x004257.en: 「Damn you.../ I obtained the variable factor!」

0x0042A1.en: 「Why, when I am the New Progenitor...!?」

0x0042D5.en: 「The terms and situation differ.../ yet.../ am I heading to the same result...!?」

0x004341.en: 「I'll change it.../ this cursed fate! Without fail!」

0x00438B.en: 「Why do mere mortals come this far...!」

0x0043BC.en: 「What is this...!?/ What power is at work...!?」

0x004403.en: 「The Akasha variable factor/ should be in full effect...!」

0x004469.en: 「Whatever you do,/ the outcome is preordained.」

0x0044B3.en: 「Those who defy god face divine punishment.」

0x004515.en: 「That relentless will to fight.../ that is why you were deemed a threat.」

0x0045FE.en: 「A plan carefully laid over long years.../ I'll let nothing stand in its way.」

0x004660.en: 「I grant you not shackles, but death.」

0x0046DD.en: 「I won't repeat the same mistake.../ this time, I change fate.」

0x004733.en: 「You are an eyesore... now as ever.」

0x004764.en: 「I'll allow you to meddle in my fate no further.」

0x0047A1.en: 「In that final battle.../ you had far more varied brethren then.」

0x004806.en: 「Can't you see the gap in power, Levi?」

0x0048B8.en: 「That man... should I absorb him rather than destroy him...?」

0x0048FB.en: 「That machine's foundation/ is what I gave to Aulef.」

0x00494E.en: 「You can't change my fate./ Nor your own destiny.」

0x0049D8.en: 「The weak may swarm, but the result is clear.」

0x004A58.en: 「I transcend.../ not just the fool-emperor, but the creator-god too.」

0x004AA2.en: 「Stay your hand; bless the New Progenitor's birth」

0x004AD9.en: 「You've no intent to quietly await your ruin.」

0x004B8D.en: 「Yes... you defied me back then, too.」

0x004BCA.en: 「That power... it's hardly changed/ in this world either.」

0x004C1D.en: 「I know you... from the distant past.」

0x004C5A.en: 「My battles with you... I even feel nostalgic.」

0x004C9A.en: 「Even if you board Judecca,/ you cannot defeat me.」

0x004D18.en: 「Ing,/ I've no wish to deepen our bond further.」

0x004D96.en: 「An SRX short of its true form can't beat me.」

0x004DD3.en: 「Don't think an incomplete machine can defeat me.」

0x005018.en: 「The one fit to rule this new paradise/　is me - the New Progenitor...」

0x005099.en: 「My eternal paradise needs no old bloodline...」

0x0050F2.en: 「The Adam of old was cast/　out from Eden...」

0x005167.en: 「Even reincarnated,/　there is no place for you...」

0x005216.en: 「Souls of the dead... receive this curse.」

0x00524D.en: 「From the abyss... come, gather, ye dead...」

0x005290.en: 「Feel their spite in your own flesh!」

0x0052FB.en: 「Time and space cross, and you/　glimpse the cursed memory of old.」

0x0053BB.en: 「Supreme knowledge shall/　burn your very brain away...!」
